arXiv:2605.15018v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 5 月 14 日arXiv:2605.15018v1 [cs.LG] 14 May 2026

广义优先级感知 Shapley 值Generalized Priority-Aware Shapley Value

Kiljae Lee
The Ohio State University
lee.10428@osu.edu &Ziqi Liu
Carnegie Mellon University
ziqiliu2@andrew.cmu.edu Weijing Tang
Carnegie Mellon University
weijingt@andrew.cmu.edu &Yuan Zhang
The Ohio State University
yzhanghf@stat.osu.edu Corresponding author.
摘要Abstract

Shapley 值及其优先级感知扩展广泛用于机器学习中的评估，但现有方法要求成对优先级是二元和非循环的，这在真实数据示例（例如聚合的人类偏好和多标准比较）中严重违反了这一限制。 我们介绍Shapley value and its priority-aware extensions are widely used for valuation in machine learning, but existing methods require pairwise priority to be binary and acyclic, a restriction spectacularly violated in real-data examples such as aggregated human preferences and multi-criterion comparisons. We introduce the广义优先级感知 Shapley 值generalized priority-aware Shapley value（GPASV），在任意有向加权优先级图上定义的随机顺序值，其中成对边缘惩罚而不是禁止顺序违规。 GPASV 涵盖了一系列经典模型作为边界情况。 我们通过公理化表征建立 GPASV，开发相关的计算方法，并引入扩展 PASV 的优先级扫描诊断。 我们将 GPASV 应用于循环 Chatbot Arena 偏好图上的 LLM 整体评估，说明了这一点(GPASV), a random order value defined on arbitrary directed weighted priority graphs, in which pairwise edges penalize rather than forbid order violations. GPASV covers a range of classical models as boundary cases. We establish GPASV through an axiomatic characterization, develop the associated computational methods, and introduce a priority sweeping diagnostic extending PASV’s. We apply GPASV to LLM ensemble valuation on the cyclic Chatbot Arena preference graph, illustrating that优先级感知估值不是一键式操作priority-aware valuation is not a one-button operation：成对图优先级与单个软优先级的不同平衡会对相同数据产生实质性不同的评估。: different balances of pairwise graph priority versus individual soft priority produce substantively different valuations of the same data.

1 简介Introduction

沙普利值Shapley value[38]及其变体广泛用于机器学习中，以认可内容贡献者，包括训练示例、数据提供者、功能或模型组件and its variants are widely used in machine learning to accredit content contributors, including training examples, data providers, features, or model components[16, 32, 40]。 它们的吸引力在于既具有原则性（由一小组公理唯一确定）又与模型无关。 一个中心公理是对称性：贡献相同内容的两个玩家应该获得相同的功劳。 虽然这从表面上看是合理的，但它的关键漏洞是. Their appeal lies in being both principled (uniquely determined by a small set of axioms) and model-agnostic. A central axiom is symmetry: two players who contribute identical contents should receive the same credit. While this is reasonable on its face, its key vulnerability is the复印机攻击copier attack：对称性对复制者和原创者给予同等的奖励，而理性认为所有功劳都应该归于原创者。 现代人工智能/机器学习问题包含许多示例，其中出于类似或相关的原因，贡献者应因其贡献内容之外的原因而受到不同的重视：数据沿袭、功能之间的因果优先级、数据提供者之间不同的信任或成本。 最近的工作已将此上下文信息纳入 Shapley 型估值中: symmetry rewards copiers equally to originators, when rationality says all credit should go to the originators. Modern AI/ML problems contain many examples where for similar or related reasons, contributors should be valued differently for reasons beyond their contributed contents: data lineage, causal precedence among features, differing trust or cost across data providers. Recent work has incorporated this contextual information into Shapley-type valuations[41, 9]，包括优先 Shapley 值 (PSV), including precedence Shapley values (PSV)[11], 加权 Shapley 值 (WSV), weighted Shapley values (WSV)[20, 35]，机器学习适应, machine-learning adaptations[13, 46]，以及最近的优先级夏普利值 (PASV), and most recently the priority-aware Shapley value (PASV)[26].

所有这些工作的一个共同假设是，成对优先级关系可以通过A common assumption across all these works is that the pairwise priority relations can be captured by a有向无环图 (DAG)directed acyclic graph (DAG)。 DAG 假设的含义有两层： (i) 它有. The meaning of DAG assumption is two-fold: (i) it has无循环no cycles（例如，(e.g.,i→j→k→ii\to j\to k\to i）； (ii) 优先顺序是); (ii) precedences are未加权的unweighted; 许多现代人工智能/机器学习应用程序都违反了这两个方面。 循环优先级的一个突出例子是人类偏好的汇总，其中; both aspects are violated in many modern AI/ML applications. A prominent example of cyclic priority is aggregated human preferences, where孔多塞循环Condorcet cycles无处不在are ubiquitous[8, 2, 12, 29]; 多标准模型比较是类似精神的另一个例子; multi-criterion model comparison is another example in similar spirits[44]。 只要证据强度发生变化，就会出现加权优先级，包括锦标赛分析中的成对获胜计数、布拉德利-特里对数赔率. Weighted priority arises whenever the strength of evidence varies, encompassing pairwise win counts in tournament analysis, Bradley-Terry log-odds[3], ELO 评级, ELO ratings[17]，以及 Plackett-Luce 风格的价值分数, and Plackett-Luce-style worth scores[36, 31];所有这些都带有 DAG 丢弃的量级。 一些应用程序，例如 Chatbot Arena; all of these carry magnitude that a DAG discards. Some applications, such as Chatbot Arena[45, 7]，呈现循环加权优先级图。, present cyclic, weighted priority graphs.

我们建议We propose广义优先级感知 Shapley 值 (GPASV)generalized priority-aware Shapley value (GPASV)，一种同时处理循环和加权优先级图的评估方法。 从技术上讲，沙普利式估值方法都建立在参与者的排列之上（参见第, a valuation method that simultaneously handles cyclic and weighted priority graphs. Technically speaking, Shapley-style valuation methods all build on permutations of the players (see Section2）。 在这种语言中，DAG 假设相当于严格限制可接受的排列。 相反，我们的 GPASV 对于每个排列，都会计算其优先级违规的总数，并相应地对其概率进行反向加权，从而自然地处理循环和加权成对优先级。). Within this language, the DAG assumption amounts to rigidly restricting to admissible permutations. Our GPASV instead, for each permutation, counts its total amount of precedence violations and inversely weights its probability accordingly, thereby naturally handling cycles and weighted pairwise priorities.

除了以优先级图表示的成对优先级之外，GPASV 还包含了玩家级别“Apart from pairwise priority, represented by the priority graph, GPASV also incorporates the player-level “软优先级soft priority”，它对信任、成本或合规风险等个人信息进行编码。 虽然该组件的想法继承自之前的 WSV-to-PASV 系列工作，但将其与我们“升级的”优先级图组件集成需要相当重要的调整。”, which encodes individual information such as trust, cost, or compliance risk. While the idea of this component was inherited from the WSV-to-PASV line of prior work, integrating it with our “upgraded” priority-graph component requires rather nontrivial adaptation.

1.1 我们的贡献Our Contributions

方法（核心贡献）：GPASV 处理循环和加权优先级图，同时合并单独的软优先级。Method (core contribution): GPASV handles cyclic and weighted priority graphs while incorporating individual soft priority.

GPASV 是第一个同时处理循环成对优先级、加权成对优先级和个体软优先级的评估方法，同时仍然包含经典的 Shapley 值、PSV、WSV 和 PASV 作为特例。GPASV is the first valuation method that simultaneously handles cyclic pairwise priorities, weighted pairwise priorities, and individual soft priorities, while still containing the classical Shapley value, PSV, WSV, and PASV as special cases.

理论：PASV 的有原则的、富有表现力的扩展。Theory: a principled, expressive extension of PASV.

GPASV 承认一个公理化的特征，它概括了 PASV 的特征，并且 GSCF 修复了规范的阶段形式（第 1 节）GPASV admits an axiomatic characterization that generalizes PASV’s, with GSCF fixing the canonical stage-wise form (Section3.4）。 此外，在循环图上，GPASV 承认 PASV 无法表达的限制分布（第 1 节）). Furthermore, on cyclic graphs GPASV admits limiting distributions that no PASV can express (Section3.6），将 GPASV 标记为一个非常重要的扩展，而不是 PASV 的包装。), marking GPASV as a highly nontrivial extension rather than a wrapper around PASV.

可扩展的计算和加速方法。Scalable computation and acceleration methods.

我们推导了 GPASV 特定的局部相邻交换 MH 比率（命题We derive a GPASV-specific local adjacent-swap MH ratio (Proposition1）并为循环图设计阶段式贪婪初始化（算法) and design a stage-wise greedy initialization for cyclic graphs (Algorithm2），然后将这些采样组件与直接蒙特卡罗估计、实用程序缓存集成（第), then integrate these sampling components with direct Monte Carlo estimation, utility caching (SectionF.3.1），SNIS 重用用于优先级扫描（第), SNIS reuse for priority sweeping (SectionF.3.2），以及根据基于回归的半值方法改编的代理辅助估计器（第), and a surrogate-assisted estimator adapted from regression-based semi-value methods (SectionF.2.2）。 虽然一些加速组件建立在标准蒙特卡罗和回归代理思想的基础上，但它们对 GPASV 排列分布和优先级扫描工作流程的适应显着增强了可扩展性。). While some acceleration components build on standard Monte Carlo and regression-surrogate ideas, their adaptation to the GPASV permutation distribution and priority-sweeping workflow significantly enhances scalability.

诊断：GPASV 下的优先级扫描显示出比 PASV 下更大的软优先级影响。Diagnostic: priority sweeping under GPASV reveals larger soft-priority effects than under PASV.

我们将 PASV 的优先级全面诊断扩展到 GPASV。 一个核心发现是个人软优先事项的影响We extend PASV’s priority sweeping diagnostic to GPASV. A central finding is that the impact of individual soft prioritiesλ\lambda由于软化的成对优先级关系，GPASV 下的值比 PASV 下的大得多。 这带来了两个实际影响：优先级扫描对于解释 GPASV 估值来说变得至关重要，而不是可选的，而可转换为软优先级的元数据的收集变得更加重要。is substantially larger under GPASV than under PASV, due to the softened pairwise priority relations. This carries two practical implications: priority sweeping becomes essential rather than optional for interpreting GPASV valuations, and metadata translatable into soft priorities becomes far more consequential to collect.

验证和应用。Validation and application.

广泛的模拟验证了 GPASV 的准确性并证实了我们的理论预测。 在 MT-Bench 和循环 Chatbot Arena 偏好图上对 LLM 集成评估进行的大规模实验证明了 GPASV 的实用性和可扩展性。Extensive simulations validate GPASV’s accuracy and confirm our theoretical predictions. A large-scale experiment on LLM ensemble valuation on MT-Bench and the cyclic Chatbot Arena preference graph demonstrates GPASV’s practicality and scalability.

3.1 PASV 的局限性和推广的动机Limitations of PASV and Motivation for a Generalization

PASV 将硬优先级编码为二进制 DAG，这在现代 AI/ML 应用程序中可能会受到限制。PASV encodes hard priority as a binary DAG, which can be restrictive in modern AI/ML applications.

硬优先级在实践中可能并不那么“难”。Hard priority may not be that “hard” in practice.在（In (3），每条边), every edge ofGG作为绝对约束强制执行：任何is enforced as an absolute constraint: anyπ\pi即使侵犯一条边缘也被排除。 但真正的成对优先级通常是程度问题而不是黑白问题。 例如，NeurIPS 2026 在 2026 年 3 月 1 日划了一条线：之前出现的论文被视为先前的工作，之后出现的论文被视为并发工作violating even one edge is ruled out. But real pairwise priority is often a matter of degree rather than black/white. For example, NeurIPS 2026 draws a line at March 1, 2026: papers appearing before are treated as prior work, those after as concurrent[34]，即使前一天/后一天发布的两篇论文具有几乎相同的优先级。 同样，领域专家可能相信功能, even though two papers posted one day before/after carry nearly identical priority. Similarly, a domain expert may believe featureii因果影响特征causally impacts featurejj基于信息丰富但非决定性的证据。 在这两种情况下，PASV 都会丢弃幅度信息并对边界边缘变得敏感。based on informative but non-determining evidence. In both cases, PASV discards magnitude information and becomes sensitive to borderline edges.

成对优先级可以是循环的。Pairwise priority may be cyclic.PASV 需要PASV requiresGG成为非循环的。 但是，当优先级在总体或标准之间聚合时，循环成对信号自然会出现。 在汇总人类偏好中，模型to be acyclic. But cyclic pairwise signals arise naturally when priority is aggregated across a population or across criteria. In aggregated human preferences, modelii可能会打败may beatjj, jj节拍beatskk，然而, and yetkk节拍beatsii– 经典孔多塞循环– the classical Condorcet cycle[2, 12]，在 LLM 偏好网络中出现的概率很高, shown to occur with high probability in LLM preference networks[29]。 多标准比较可以类似地循环：. 6 应用：人类偏好图下的LLM评估Application: LLM Evaluation under Human Preference Graphs

我们使用 Chatbot Arena 的 GPASV 来进行 LLM 整体评估We apply GPASV to LLM ensemble valuation, using Chatbot Arena’s[7]成对的人类偏好作为 PASV 无法处理的循环加权优先级图。 众所周知，人类对法学硕士的总体偏好包含高概率的循环pairwise human preferences as a cyclic, weighted priority graph that PASV cannot handle. Aggregated human preferences over LLMs are known to contain cycles with high probability[29]，因此循环感知方法不是特殊情况，而是此应用程序的基本要素。 主要的结论是，估值不应被视为从数据中自动读取的单一、最佳选择的数字。 相反，用户必须决定如何权衡软的、个人的优先级与成对的用户偏好优先级，并且这种选择会对最终的评估产生重大影响。, so a cycle-aware method is not a corner case but an essential ingredient for this application. The main takeaway is that valuation should not be treated as a single, best-chosen number automatically read off from the data. Instead, the user must decide how to weigh soft, individual priorities against pairwise user-preference priorities, and this choice materially affects the eventual valuation.

7 主要要点和局限性Key Takeaway and Limitations

带回家的消息。Take-home message.优先级感知估值是Priority-aware valuation is不是一键操作not a one-button operation：只要同时存在玩家级别和成对优先级信息（例如，开源部署偏好 + Chatbot Arena 偏好图），用户必须决定如何平衡这两个来源，并且最终的估值在很大程度上取决于该决定。 这是: whenever both player-level and pairwise priority information are present (e.g., open-source deployment preference + Chatbot Arena preference graph), the user must decide how to balance the two sources, and the resulting valuation can materially depend on that decision. This is不是方法级别的不一致，而是问题的自然属性not a method-level inconsistency but a natural property of the problem：除非指定外部目标，否则仅靠数据无法确定唯一正确的优先级权衡；不同的评估者偏好定义了不同的一致评估。 GPASV 的价值在于保持这些建模选择可见：它将优先级权衡公开为显式的、可扫描的输入，并接受循环优先级图，而无需首先将其简化为 DAG。: unless an external objective is specified, the data alone cannot identify a uniquely correct priority trade-off; different evaluator preferences define different coherent valuations. The value of GPASV is to keep these modeling choices visible: it exposes the priority trade-off as an explicit, sweepable input and accepts cyclic priority graphs without first reducing them to a DAG.

局限性。Limitations.我们讨论两个主要限制：实用程序调用和优先级图稳定性。 由于页数限制，我们将详细讨论放在附录中We discuss two main limitations: utility calls and priority graph stability. Due to page limit, we relegate the detailed discussion to AppendixA.

GPASV 的主要计算成本在于对联盟效用的重复评估The main computational cost of GPASV lies in repeated evaluations of the coalition utilityU​(S)U(S)。 这种成本基本上由随机顺序系列中所有与模型无关的数据评估方法共同承担，并且在我们看来，这是不可避免的：任何处理. This cost is shared by essentially all model-agnostic data valuation methods in the random-order family, and is, in our view, unavoidable: any method that treatsUU因为黑匣子除了查询之外没有任何追索权，并且边际贡献的准确估计会施加与玩家数量成比例的最小查询预算。 当每次查询时，成本变得尤为突出as a black box has no recourse but to query it, and accurate estimation of marginal contributions imposes a minimum query budget that scales with the number of players. The cost becomes especially salient when each query toUU本身就很昂贵，就像在Section的LLM整体设置中一样is itself expensive, as in the LLM ensemble setting of Section6，其中评估, where evaluatingU​(S)U(S)对于单个联盟，需要在所有联盟上运行一个 LLM 作为聚合器和一个 LLM 作为法官for a single coalition requires running an LLM-as-an-aggregator and an LLM-as-a-judge over all8080MT-Bench 问题，包括MT-Bench questions, with2020候选模型给予candidate models giving2202^{20}可能的联盟。possible coalitions.

为了解决这个限制，我们的框架结合了三个计算设备，它们与 GPASV 定义一起工作，而不是事后附加。 子集缓存（部分To address this limitation, our framework incorporates three computational devices that work jointly with the GPASV definition rather than being bolted on after the fact. Subset caching (Section4）利用了相同子集的事实) exploits the fact that the same subsetSS在基于排列的估计器和基于代理的估计器中重复多次，因此每个不同recurs many times across both the permutation-based estimator and the surrogate-based estimator, so each distinctU​(S)U(S)最多评估一次。 自归一化重要性抽样（部分is evaluated at most once. Self-normalized importance sampling (SectionF.3.2）重用已经在一个下绘制的排列) reuses permutations already drawn under one(λ,ω)(\lambda,\omega)估计相邻参数值处的 GPASV，这就是第 5 节中优先扫描的原因to estimate GPASV at neighboring parameter values, which is what makes the priority sweeps in Section6实惠。 两阶段代理调整残差估计器（第affordable. The two-stage surrogate-adjusted residual estimator (SectionF.2.2）通过将大部分信号吸收到拟合代理中并将剩余查询预算用于残差校正，进一步减少每个实用程序查询的方差。 这些设备共同实现了法学硕士的完整应用) further reduces variance per utility query by absorbing most of the signal into a fitted surrogate and spending the remaining query budget on residual correction. Together, these devices allow the full LLM application of Section6，包括其优先扫描，将在固定且适度的法学硕士呼叫预算内进行。, including its priority sweeps, to be carried out within a fixed and modest LLM-call budget.

A.2 优先级图Priority Graph

第二个限制涉及优先级图本身。 在本文中，我们将优先级图视为给定的输入，并研究它如何形成最终的估值，但在实践中，该图通常是根据有限的、噪声的或部分观察到的数据来估计的，就像第 1 节中使用的 Chatbot Arena 成对偏好的情况一样。A second limitation concerns the priority graph itself. Throughout this paper we treat the priority graph as a given input and study how it shapes the resulting valuation, but in practice the graph is often estimated from finite, noisy, or partially observed data, as is the case for the Chatbot Arena pairwise preferences used in Section6。 有限时. At finiteβ\beta，GPASV 仍然是边权重的平滑函数，但是, GPASV remains a smooth function of the edge weights, but theβ→∞\beta\to\infty硬性处罚边界可以放大违规成本中的密切联系。 因此，优先级扫描可以诊断经验不稳定性，但它们不是正式的统计误差线。对噪声估计图导出有限样本误差界限或更清晰的稳定性诊断超出了目前的工作范围，是未来研究的重要方向。hard-penalty boundary can amplify near-ties in violation cost. Hence priority sweeps can diagnose empirical instability, but they are not formal statistical error bars. Deriving finite-sample error bounds or sharper stability diagnostics for noisy estimated graphs is beyond the present work and is an important direction for future research.

附录FAppendix FGPASV 的计算细节Computational Details for GPASV

部分Section4概述了高级计算管道。本附录收集了详细的推导和算法。outlines the high-level computational pipeline. This appendix collects the detailed derivations and algorithms.

F.1 排列抽样Permutation Sampling

GPASV 被定义为下的期望GPASV is defined as an expectation underp(λ,ω)p^{(\lambda,\omega)}，因此主要的计算原语是从此分布中采样排列。 我们描述了一个具有局部接受率的相邻交换 Metropolis-Hastings 采样器（第 1 节）, so the principal computational primitive is sampling permutations from this distribution. We describe an adjacent-swap Metropolis–Hastings sampler with a local acceptance ratio (SectionF.1.1），以及反映 GPASV 选择因子的贪婪初始化（第), and a greedy initialization that mirrors the GPASV choice factor (SectionF.1.2).

F.1.1 相邻交换大都会-黑斯廷斯采样器Adjacent-Swap Metropolis–Hastings Sampler

GPASV 被定义为关于整个空间上的排列分布的期望GPASV is defined as an expectation with respect to a permutation distribution on the full spaceΠ\Pi。 因此，主要的计算任务是大约从. Accordingly, the main computational task is to sample permutations approximately fromp(λ,ω)p^{(\lambda,\omega)}。 相邻交换 Metropolis-Hastings (MH) 是一种规范的局部采样排列方法，适用于均匀和非均匀设置. Adjacent-swap Metropolis-Hastings (MH) is a canonical local approach for sampling permutations, both in uniform and non-uniform settings[22, 4, 26]。 我们采用这个建议是因为它保留了排列结构，同时允许目标分布是整个空间上的 GPASV 分布. We adopt this proposal because it preserves the permutation structure while allowing the target distribution to be the GPASV distribution on the full spaceΠ\Pi.

让Letpp是任意目标分布be any target distribution onΠ\Pi并让and letq​(π,π′)q(\pi,\pi^{\prime})是一个提案内核。 一般 MH 接受概率为be a proposal kernel. The general MH acceptance probability is

AMH(π,π′):=min{1,p​(π′)​q​(π′,π)p​(π)​q​(π,π′)}.A_{\mathrm{MH}}(\pi,\pi^{\prime}):=\min\left\{1,\,\frac{p(\pi^{\prime})q(\pi^{\prime},\pi)}{p(\pi)q(\pi,\pi^{\prime})}\right\}. (35)

在我们的实现中，考虑到当前的排列In our implementation, given the current permutationπ=(π1,…,πn)\pi=(\pi_{1},\dots,\pi_{n})，我们选择一个索引, we choose an indexi∈[n−1]i\in[n-1]均匀随机并提出uniformly at random and proposeπ′\pi^{\prime}通过交换相邻对by swapping the adjacent paira:=πia:=\pi_{i}, b:=πi+1b:=\pi_{i+1}。 这个相邻交换提议是对称的，所以. This adjacent-swap proposal is symmetric, soq​(π,π′)=q​(π′,π)q(\pi,\pi^{\prime})=q(\pi^{\prime},\pi)以及 (and the proposal term in (35) 取消。 因此接受概率降低为) cancels. Therefore the acceptance probability reduces to

AMH​(π,π′)=min⁡{1,p(λ,ω)​(π′)p(λ,ω)​(π)}.A_{\mathrm{MH}}(\pi,\pi^{\prime})=\min\left\{1,\frac{p^{(\lambda,\omega)}(\pi^{\prime})}{p^{(\lambda,\omega)}(\pi)}\right\}.

F.3 通过计算重用加速Acceleration via Computational Reuse

上面的采样器解决了 GPASV 的分配方面的问题，但在许多应用中，主要成本并不是 MH 移动本身。 相反，它往往是对合作博弈的重复评估。 这种不平衡在更广泛的 Shapley 文献中是众所周知的：在特征归因中，效用评估可能需要许多模型推论The sampler above addresses the distributional side of GPASV, but in many applications the dominant cost is not the MH move itself. Rather, it is often the repeated evaluation of the cooperative game. This imbalance is well known in the broader Shapley literature: in feature attribution, utility evaluation may require many model inferences[32];在数据评估中，可能需要重复的模型再训练; in data valuation, it may require repeated model retraining[16, 40]。 这激发了两种互补的加速机制：重用重复子集的效用评估，以及重用附近目标分布的排列。. This motivates two complementary acceleration mechanisms: reusing utility evaluations on repeated subsets, and reusing permutations across nearby target distributions.

F.3.1 跨重复子集的实用程序重用Utility Reuse Across Repeated Subsets

这里描述的实用程序缓存机制适用于章节中的两个估计器The utility-caching mechanism described here applies to both estimators in SectionsF.2.1和andF.2.2。 给定采样排列. Given sampled permutationsπ(1),…,π(NMC)\pi^{(1)},\dots,\pi^{(N_{\mathrm{MC}})}，估计 GPASV 需要边际贡献, estimating GPASV requires the marginal contributionsΔi​(π(m);U)\Delta_{i}(\pi^{(m)};U)从 (from (37):

Δi​(π(m);U),i∈[n],m∈[NMC],\Delta_{i}(\pi^{(m)};U),\quad i\in[n],\ m\in[N_{\mathrm{MC}}],

每一项由由相对顺序导出的子集确定Each term is determined by a subset induced by the relative order inπ(m)\pi^{(m)}。 因为相邻交换提案仅在本地修改排列，并且因为许多采样排列共享长初始段，所以相同的子集经常在 MCMC 迭代和玩家之间重复出现。. Because adjacent-swap proposals modify permutations only locally, and because many sampled permutations share long initial segments, the same subset often appears repeatedly across MCMC iterations and across players.

因此，我们维护一个由子集本身索引的效用评估缓存。 每当一个子集We therefore maintain a cache of utility evaluations indexed by the subset itself. Whenever a subsetSS第一次遇到，我们评价is encountered for the first time, we evaluateU​(S)U(S)一次并存储结果；同一子集的每次出现都会重用缓存的值。 相同的缓存适用于once and store the result; every later appearance of the same subset reuses the cached value. This does not change the estimator at all, but it can reduce the number of expensive utility calls by a large factor.

实际结果是总运行时间自然分为两部分：The practical consequence is that the total runtime separates naturally into two parts:

runtime≈(#​ unique subsets)×(cost per utility evaluation)+(sampling overhead).\text{runtime}\approx(\#\text{ unique subsets})\times(\text{cost per utility evaluation})\;+\;(\text{sampling overhead}).

这种分解在 LLM 评估等应用中尤其重要，其中效用计算可能比采样排列昂贵得多。This decomposition is particularly important in applications such as LLM evaluation, where utility computation can be much more expensive than sampling permutations.

G.2.4 匹配预算替代比较协议Matched-Budget Surrogate Comparison Protocol

MT-Bench 的联盟实用程序。Coalition utility from MT-Bench.

MT-Bench 包括MT-Bench consists ofQ=80Q=80两轮提示分为八个类别，每个类别有十个提示：two-turn prompts organized into eight categories with ten prompts each:写作Writing, 角色扮演Roleplay, 推理Reasoning, 数学Math, 编码Coding, 萃取Extraction, 知识一Knowledge I, 和, and知识二Knowledge II。 发布的基准测试捆绑了每个玩家的第一轮和第二轮模型响应，并且这些响应在整个实验过程中被视为固定的候选答案；我们从不重新查询. The released benchmark bundles first- and second-turn model responses for every player, and these responses are treated as fixed candidate answers throughout the experiment; we never re-query the2020玩家自己。 遵循 MT-Bench 评审协议，我们使用两种评审变体。 对于players themselves. Following the MT-Bench judging protocol, we use two judge variants. For推理Reasoning, 数学Math, 和, and编码Coding，法官会得到 MT-Bench 发布的参考答案，并被要求对相对于它的正确性进行评分（带参考变体）。 对于其余五个类别，法官直接根据用户提示和助理响应（无参考变体）对答案进行评分。 对于一个联盟来说, the judge is given MT-Bench’s released reference answer and is asked to score correctness relative to it (with-reference variant). For the remaining five categories the judge scores the answer directly from the user prompt and the assistant response (no-reference variant). 聚合器和判断器都被实例化为Both the aggregator and the judge are instantiated withQwen3.5-35B-A3B-FP8 [37]。 选择该模型是因为 (i) 它足够强大，可以可靠地聚合和评分 MT-Bench 响应，但 (ii) FP8 形式足够小，可以在本地批量提供服务. The aggregator receives the user prompt together with a randomly shuffled list of candidate responses, each delimited by explicit start/end markers, and is instructed to merge, edit, and reorganize the candidates while preserving the user’s requested format and without adding external facts. For the second turn, the first-turn aggregated answeryS(1)y^{(1)}_{S}在呈现第二轮候选者之前插入作为先前的辅助消息。 无参考判断提示包括is inserted as the previous assistant message before presenting the second-turn candidates. For second-turn judging, the full two-turn conversation is presented in the助理AAssistant A格式，以便对回合之间的一致性进行评分，而不是对每个回合进行孤立评分。 在所有变体中，法官都会被要求做出简短的解释，然后做出最终的裁决format, so that coherence across turns is scored rather than each turn in isolation. In all variants, the judge is asked for a brief explanation followed by a final[[评级]][[rating]]于on the11–1010规模。 占位符scale.
